subject: Electrical Engineering
title: EMC: Taming Electromagnetic Noise
description: A quick, practical guide to EMC: Taming Electromagnetic Noise.

hook.text: A blender turns on and your radio crackles. Devices leak electromagnetic noise.

buildup.text: EMC ensures devices neither emit too much noise nor break when exposed to it.

discovery.text: Shielding wraps circuits in metal. Filtering blocks unwanted frequencies at ports.

twist.text: Every wire is an antenna. Even a PCB trace can broadcast or receive interference.

climax.text: Medical devices, aircraft, and cars must pass strict EMC testing before sale.

punchline.text: Good engineering means your devices coexist in silence.

quiz.question: What does electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) ensure?
options: Devices run on the same voltage standard worldwide
Devices neither emit harmful noise nor malfunction from external interference
All wireless devices use the same frequency band
